notes_for_editor: Thin record. The three site pages agree on 1936 (L-4 tower) and 1952 (destroyed), but they appear to rest on one Kresek-attributed inventory, so this is not independent confirmation. No newspaper, Forest Service or site-visit source found. Web searches for 'Mount Margaret' mostly return unrelated places (Mount St. Helens' Mount Margaret, a Colorado trail, a Snoqualmie Pass camp); the willhiteweb 'Mount Margaret Lookout Camp' page concerns St. Helens and is not used. The record's 'access unknown' is kept by omitting an access fact. Elevation 3,765 ft is now recorded in facts; no height is recorded because no source gives the tower height.
